## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD4: github-bootstrap.sh push escape hatch conditional on merge.strategy=direct OR unprovisioned Ruleset; clear error for PR-mode with pre-existing Ruleset; absent key defaults to direct behavior

## Implementation

File: plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/github-bootstrap.sh (modify)

Before the `git push origin HEAD:main` call, add a merge.strategy check:

```bash
_MERGE_STRATEGY=""
_CONF="$REPO_ROOT/.claude/dso-config.conf"
if [ -f "$_CONF" ]; then
    _MERGE_STRATEGY=$(grep '^merge\.strategy=' "$_CONF" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2- || true)
fi
_MERGE_STRATEGY="${_MERGE_STRATEGY:-direct}"

if [ "$_MERGE_STRATEGY" = "pr" ]; then
    # PR mode with existing Ruleset: bootstrap push is unsafe
    if gh api --paginate "repos/$REPO/rulesets" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"DSO CI Enforcement"'; then
        echo "ERROR: PR-mode detected and Ruleset 'DSO CI Enforcement' already exists on $REPO." >&2
        echo "To complete bootstrap, disable the Ruleset for the bootstrap window, run github-bootstrap.sh again, then re-enable." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    # PR mode without Ruleset: fall through to provision (existing behavior)
fi
# direct mode OR PR mode without Ruleset: proceed with push
```

Key invariant: absent merge.strategy (missing key OR missing config file) → treat as direct (push proceeds). This preserves backward compatibility for all existing projects.

## TDD Requirement
Modify tests/scripts/test-github-bootstrap.sh to add THREE test functions BEFORE implementing:
1. test_pr_mode_with_existing_ruleset_emits_error — mock gh with existing Ruleset, temp dso-config.conf with merge.strategy=pr; assert: push not attempted, stderr contains "disable" AND "Ruleset", exit non-zero
2. test_pr_mode_without_existing_ruleset_calls_provision_ruleset — mock gh with NO Ruleset, temp dso-config.conf with merge.strategy=pr; assert: provision-ruleset.sh called, exit 0
3. test_missing_merge_strategy_defaults_to_direct_behavior — temp dir with NO dso-config.conf (or empty config); assert: push attempted, exit 0 (same as current direct-mode behavior)
All three must FAIL before implementation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All existing test-github-bootstrap.sh tests still pass
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-github-bootstrap.sh
- [ ] test_pr_mode_with_existing_ruleset_emits_error passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-github-bootstrap.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'test_pr_mode_with_existing_ruleset_emits_error.*PASS'
- [ ] test_pr_mode_without_existing_ruleset_calls_provision_ruleset passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-github-bootstrap.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'test_pr_mode_without_existing_ruleset_calls_provision_ruleset.*PASS'
- [ ] test_missing_merge_strategy_defaults_to_direct_behavior passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-github-bootstrap.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'test_missing_merge_strategy_defaults_to_direct_behavior.*PASS'
- [ ] grep guard: missing config file treated as direct (not an error)
  Verify: (covered by test 3 above)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Update github-bootstrap.sh to gate push on merge.strategy and handle PR-mode error
